parts.title: Getting around
questions: How do you normally travel to a place you visit often?
What information do you check before going somewhere unfamiliar?
Do you like travelling with other people?
What makes a route comfortable for walking?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe a journey where you had to change your original plan.
questions: Say where you intended to go.
Describe how you chose another route.
Explain what you would do differently next time.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: How can transport information help someone who rarely uses public transport?
What makes a walking route accessible to different people?
Should towns invest first in making existing routes reliable or in creating new routes?
What can travellers learn from a disruption that a schedule alone does not show?
